title: SharePoint Online External Sharing & Access Governance
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft 365 SharePoint administration).

SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Control external sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive without blocking work
problem: External sharing in SharePoint/OneDrive drives collaboration and data leakage in equal measure. This solution governs external sharing and access: tenant and site-level sharing settings, sharing-link defaults and expiration, allow/block domains, sensitivity-label-driven controls, guest access and access reviews, and reporting on external exposure — so sharing is enabled but controlled and auditable.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the sharing model: tenant vs site sharing, link types + defaults + expiration, allow/block, sensitivity-driven controls, guests, and exposure reporting.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (SPO admin + Entra, data-classification/sensitivity posture, stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — set tenant + site sharing, link defaults + expiration, allow/block domains, sensitivity-driven controls, guest access reviews, and stand up external-exposure reporting — pilot-first, each setting named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (sharing scoped to policy, external exposure visible, stale access reviewed) plus Best Practices for safe external sharing.
short: Govern SharePoint/OneDrive external sharing & access — tenant + site settings, link defaults/expiration, allow/block domains, sensitivity controls, guest reviews, and exposure reporting — so sharing is enabled but controlled. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
